title: DefenSee: Dissecting Threat from Sight and Text — A Multi-View Defensive Pipeline for Multi-modal Jailbreaks
reasoning: The paper focuses on cybersecurity and the development of a defensive pipeline (DefenSee) to protect Multi-modal Large Language Models from jailbreak attacks. While it evaluates the system against categories that include 'unethical' content within safety benchmarks, its primary contribution is a defensive security architecture, not a research component focused on ethics, morality, or religion.
